lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12V2Cr2 (reduced formula Mg6VCr) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows that Cr and V centers each have 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Mg centers display 12-, 16-, and 14-neighbor environments, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.85 to 3.55 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg and V polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg polyhedra.
